title: Segmentation fault in "torch::autograd::Engine::evaluate_function"  in 1.3.1

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: module: autograd
labels.description: Related to torch.autograd, and the autograd engine in general

labels.name: module: cuda
labels.description: Related to torch.cuda, and CUDA support in general

body:
I've been getting segmentation faults when running Nvidia SPADE repo (https://github.com/NVlabs/SPADE) with default parameters on AWS (Deep Learning AMI (Ubuntu 18.04) Version 26.0 and pytorch_p36 environment).

I'm using default parameters, one time it happened on 1st epoch, another was 4th epoch of training. (30 mins in). I've seen this using 1 GPU DataParallel and 8 GPU DataParallel. However, much longer runs using 8 and 16 GPU DDP didn't crash. Also, single GPU version seemed to work fine on a local (gaming GPU).

Below is the version info and core-dump, any suggestions how to narrow down the cause? 
